study type: Retrospective nationwide study with comparative interrupted time series analysis
exposure: Medical policies from 'The Evaluation of the Appropriate Use of Prophylactic Antibiotics'
cohort: The study included 177,468 patients who underwent spine surgery (SS) and 89,372 patients who underwent hip arthroplasty surgery (HAS) from the Korean National Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service database.
finding: The medical policy was effective in reducing the usage and duration of antibiotics, especially in the first 2-5 years after implementation, and resulted in a 3% reduced LOS for spine surgery in the first 2 years, with mixed effects on direct medical costs.
followup_time: Up to 5 years after policy implementation (within a study period of 2011-2018)
